open_decisions.question: PORTTEST is classified test_tool with inferred confidence (conflict: its path src/programs/portfolio/PORTTEST.cbl does not indicate a test tool). It writes up to 100 synthetic portfolio records (BR-101), derives keys from the record count (BR-102) and sets a random total value with a 10% cash balance (BR-103). Is PORTTEST modernised, retired, replaced by a framework/test-data service, or kept as test tooling?

PORTTEST is classified test_tool (inferred): classified as test_tool (inferred); a human must decide whether it is in modernisation scope. Keep it in the modernisation scope (resolved_no_change) or exclude it (excluded_from_scope)?

Which character encoding (code page) do the files and areas described by these copybooks use for DISPLAY data on the legacy platform (EBCDIC 037, 1140, another EBCDIC variant, or ASCII)? The zoned-decimal test vectors and String codecs depend on it.

If PORTTEST is kept: GAP-075 - the generation loop (line 48) ends only when successful writes reach 100, so a persistent WRITE failure never ends it; GAP-089 - STRING 'PORT' WS-RECORD-COUNT INTO PORT-ID puts 9 characters into 8 without ON OVERFLOW (line 83), MOVE FUNCTION RANDOM to a PIC 9(1) subscript yields 0 and is used as a reference-modification start (line 87), and COMPUTE targets the alphanumeric PORT-ACCOUNT-NO (line 88). How should these be treated?
